english: It seems the traps end here.
Phew, that was tense, desuu…
Good work, [MERU]-san.
We haven't searched this area, is that fine?
If Satoko says so, no doubt about it.
The traps from the forest to here\nwere laid as if to guide us\nto this place.
This is where the Polyal is, right?
I wonder if there's some meaning to it?
…If you understand what I'm after,\nyou should get it.
The black Rika… she's shown herself!
What are you after?
Isn't it obvious?\nUntil we obtain the future I - we - desire,\nwe'll keep wandering to other worlds.
That's no longer possible.\nOyashiro-sama's power isn't that strong anymore -\nyou must know that too.
You just give up, saying it's already hopeless.\nIsn't that why\nyou can't move toward the future?
That's…
Don't be intimidated!\nA goal that demands Rika's death as its price -\nno reason could ever justify it!
Right! An ideal built on sacrifice\nis wrong!
Even if you say you'll repeat the same time again,\nunlike magic,\nlives WILL be lost!
I'm not asking for understanding.\nWe're different from you… fundamentally.
What do you mean, different?
You don't need to know.\nEither way, we part here.
So she's not backing down.
We're not backing down either!\nThis is OUR Hinamizawa! Give it back!
There's no escape…
I don't accept it… I won't!
Take it back… it's there… isn't it?
Everyone'll be wiped out by the alien invasion!
Creepy, this is… I feel sick.
I feel a visceral disgust.
Losing to yourself is the worst!
Don't overthink it.\nThe target is Rika-chan - don't forget that!
…This is… awful…!
Unforgivable… I'll curse you… I'll curse you!\nI'llcursey ouI'llcursey ouI'llcursey ouI'llcursey ou\nI'llcursey ouI'llcursey ouI'llcursey ouI'llcursey ou.
Lies!!
They're out!
Expected!
Everyone! Protective formation around Rika!
You won't have your way!
We'll turn the tables on them!
I can at least be\nRika-san's bullet shield! …Right?
I don't accept this world… never…!\nWhere are you…!!
…I just wanted to be together… together…!\nFor that alone…!
A promise… there's a promise… a promise…!!
I found it… a place\nI want to be… I did…!
I must take it back… absolutely…!
I won't lose… I've decided\nto stand against fate…!
You can't win.\nOyashiro-sama will never\nappear before you.
Is that so? At times like this\none should think from the other's perspective.\nIf you can't think of anything, you've lost?
That's strange… if you knew Oyashiro-sama's power,\nyou'd know it's impossible…!
You're the one who doesn't understand.\nThat will be your limit - and your downfall!
This is the world's choice… you call this fate…?
For you, from the very start, there was no road\nleading to the future you sought…
It's over.
Tell me one last thing.\nWhat did you want to do in a new Hinamizawa?
To redo the world… to undo\nan irreparable mistake,\nthere was no other way…
What irreparable mistake?
I can't tell you that.
Why not!?
You'll soon understand why I can't tell you…\nAnd you'll understand… what it was\nwe tried to do…
Vague as ever.\nStill resisting at this point, huh.
Resistance? Yes… this is resistance.
Could you say it\nso I can understand? I wonderr
I'll tell you just one thing.\nOnce we obtained Oyashiro-sama's power,\nwe planned to destroy the walls between worlds.
Eh!?
Destroy the walls between worlds!?\nWhat happens if you do?
Hehe… don't you find it interesting?\nIf we connected to other worlds,\nhow far would Oyashiro-sama's power spread, I wonder?
Wh…!!
I bet on that.\nWe would surely have found a way\nto restore Oyashiro-sama's weakened power…!
And once more… our…\nHinamizawa…
…She's… gone?
So she wasn't human after all?
I don't know. But I don't think they were machines,\nor monsters either.
Right. It's hard to think someone with such strong feelings\nis just a well-made fake.
In the end, we never learned what they were.
We had no leeway to capture them.
They never stopped fighting,\nto the last one, until their fates ran out.\nThis outcome was unavoidable.
So Hinamizawa will be at peace now?
We don't know how Mie and Kei will move next,\nbut there's no mystery like before.\nWe'll be fine!
Rika-chan, finally… summer is passing.
(Oyashiro-sama's power isn't for\nredoing the past.\nIt's for seizing the future…)
(You never despaired to the very end.\nFor that alone, I'll praise you.\nMy other self…)
Rika-chan?
Ah,
Yeeess.
──A few days later
July… I finally got past it…
Hinamizawa is peace itself.\nAs if nothing had ever happened…
Is this really the road to the future I wished for?\nI'm still not sure…
I'm anxious. That I might return\nto those repeating days again.
But, right now…
I want to share the joy\nof welcoming this summer with my friends.
You feel the same, don't you?
//END
